newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: F&N's says property earnings to fall.
newsitem.headline: F&N's says property earnings to fall.

text.p: Food and beverage group Fraser & Neave (F&N) said on Friday that it expected pretax profit from property development to almost half to about Singapore $120 million in 1997 from S$235.98 million in 1996.
It said that earnings from its two large condominium projects Valley Park and Anchorage had peaked for the financial year ended September 30 1996.

"Both projects will be completed during the current year when it is expected that pretax profit from property development will fall to approximately S$120 million," F&N said in a statement accompanying its full year results.
The group reported an 18.2 percent rise in earnings to S$218.43 million for 1996, a figure largely in line with analysts' expectations.
F&N said earnings from its investment properties should be at least maintained while earnings from its core soft drinks operation are expected to show good growth.
The group, through its subsidiary Asia Pacific Breweries Ltd, will expand its brewery operations this year with the commissioning of two new breweries in Phnom Penh, Cambodia and Hainan, China.
But start-up costs from these ventures are expected to dampen group earnings in the short term, it said.
It expects some recovery in dairy operations.
